title: Integrate prompt feedback kernel and Leeseo wishlist into Handshake workflows
operator_request: Include the assistant prompt feedback kernel handoff and Leeseo wishlist as a future Handshake workflow connected to Atelier/Comfy/intake.

lifecycle.claim_recovery_reason: Status recovery: legacy RFV contract lacked lifecycle.claimed_by; Kernel Builder inspected current MT state and accepts implementer-side handoff responsibility without claiming validator PASS/FAIL.

state_recovery.recovery_rule: Read both external handoff/wishlist files before implementation. Preserve their requirements explicitly; do not reduce them to generic prompt notes.

scope.summary: Turn the Leeseo prompt feedback handoff into native Handshake prompt/render review workflow connected to Atelier, ComfyUI receipts, and CKC/Ingest outputs.
base_scope: Inspect and preserve requirements from the prompt feedback kernel handoff and Leeseo wishlist.
Define import paths for prompt/render receipts and review verdicts.
Implement or stage rule-pack rewrite workflows and traceable exports.
Connect feedback records to CKC characters, ComfyUI renders, and Ingest review artifacts where relevant.
Expose model-facing headless commands and operator-visible review surfaces.
Update internal UserManual with prompt feedback workflow.
acceptance_criteria: External prompt feedback handoff and wishlist requirements are mapped to native Handshake workflow fields.
Prompt/render receipts can be imported or referenced.
Review verdicts and rewrite suggestions are persisted and traceable.
Argus can inspect and steer the prompt feedback surface.
verification: Requirement-map review against the external files.
Native UI/Argus evidence for review workflow.

legacy_rfv_evidence.summary: Committed 964db28d (2026-07-02): deterministic prompt-feedback kernel first slice. NEW self-contained atelier/prompt_feedback/ module (model/engine/adapter/mod) on PG+EventLedger+ArtifactStore (no SQLite). Leeseo CUIPP/prompt-stress import -> PromptCases; operator/model/subagent/validator/script verdicts; PURE engine (normalize->validate->evaluate_rules->rewrite->trace) with 5 seed rules + hash pool selection; every rewrite carries a trace (no freeform); JSONL export = hashed ArtifactStore artifact. Migration 0342 (5 tables). 6 API routes; frontend prompt-feedback sub-mode nested under Ingest (not a 4th tab); atelier-promptfeedback-* Argus ids; both manuals. Pre+post adversarial review found+fixed: F1 non-overridable prompt-stress->identity invariant (import + verdict paths), F2 unimplemented-rule-pack rejection, F3 feedback-distinct rewrite row, F6 export content-hash reuse, deadlock-retry (40P01/40001) for multi-writer safety, and a real render-stack mapping bug (no_detail->FaceDetailer). Proof: engine/adapter 13/13 unit; backend atelier_prompt_feedback_tests 7/7 managed PG; frontend test_atelier_panel 31/1 (1=pre-existing MT-016 :2812 = MT-044 D5). Deferred to MT-044: D8 LoRA wishlist (separate future scope), D9 panel live backend round-trip (panel is honest WIP), D10 CSV import.
legacy_rfv_evidence.note: Evidence summary copied into the MT contract for implementer-side checklist recovery only; this is not an official validator verdict.
